_comment: Example codebook for open-ended feedback about the Orbit desk lamp, a fictional product by the fictional brand Halden. Thresholds are illustrative defaults, not calibrated values.
name: orbit-lamp-feedback

codes.label: Light quality
codes.definition: The response comments on the quality of the light itself: brightness, evenness, color temperature, dimming range or flicker.
include_examples: The light is warm and even.

codes.label: Price concern
codes.definition: The response says the lamp is expensive, overpriced or questions whether it is worth the money.
include_examples: Not sure it was worth the money.

codes.label: Setup difficulty
codes.definition: The response describes trouble assembling the lamp, mounting it, or pairing it with the app.
include_examples: Screws were missing from the box.

codes.label: Feature request
codes.definition: The response asks for a feature or capability the lamp does not have.
include_examples: It should have a USB port on the base.

codes.label: Durability issue
codes.definition: The response reports a part that broke, loosened, cracked, peeled or stopped working.
include_examples: The hinge loosened after three weeks.

codes.label: Support experience
codes.definition: The response describes contact with customer support or the refund or replacement process, whether positive or negative.
include_examples: Support sent a replacement within a day.
I emailed support twice and never heard back.
